title: Christian Love
definition: Christian Love is the self-giving, truth-shaped, Christlike love that God commands and produces in His people.
summary: Love is the visible mark of those who follow Jesus.
christFocus: Jesus Christ loved His people first and commands them to love one another as He has loved them.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Christian Love describes a Spirit-formed pattern of life for those who belong to Jesus Christ. Christian living is not an attempt to earn salvation but the grateful response of people who have been saved by grace and called to walk with the Lord.

Scripture presents this truth so believers can grow in holiness, endurance, love, wisdom, worship, and mission. It touches the heart, the mind, the tongue, relationships, daily habits, and faithful obedience in ordinary life.

The emphasis of this doctrine is love is the visible mark of those who follow jesus.. It points disciples away from self-reliance and toward abiding dependence on Christ.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because discipleship can become shallow when it is reduced to information, emotion, or outward activity alone. Christian Love teaches believers how grace becomes visible in daily conduct, perseverance, relationships, and obedience to Christ.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Ask the Lord to form this truth in you through Scripture, prayer, repentance, and faithful practice. Let christian love shape how you think, speak, serve, endure, forgive, and represent Christ in the places God has assigned to you.
